verdict.rationale: TWC's registration and unemployment-tax pages are written in plain, second-person language a non-lawyer can follow. They explain liability determination, how to save and resume registration within a year, filing and paying during registration, and shared UTR/UTS logins. The site also offers monthly employer hints and how-to pages for updating or closing an account. However, the evidence shows only short explanatory snippets rather than full sequential step-by-step walkthroughs, and nothing covers broader founder tasks. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end step-by-step guides, explainers on how liability is determined, guidance beyond unemployment-tax registration, independent or hands-on corroboration of usability.
